English-medium stage 5 for maths-12-4-en. Verification dispatched as 13 parallel sub-agent batches (never pointed at step_5/PROMPT.md, each scoped to its own item list + specific rendered PDF page images), covering all 106 items, plus 3 direct follow-up page checks done by the coordinator itself (ex_4.12's boundary, q_4.51/q_4.52's question text, ex_4.18's tail arithmetic). 20 high-confidence corrections applied: a large item-boundary-bleed truncation (ex_4.12's solution had swallowed the textbook's own Theorem 1-4/Definition 4-5 exposition between Example 12 and 13, confirmed against the actual page and removed entirely - only the item's own genuine adj-A answer remains), two misattached section-header removals (q_4.42, q_4.58 - each had the FOLLOWING exercise range's own instruction sentence merged into its question field), and 17 OCR-garbling fixes spanning collapsed/dropped matrix rows-columns (the most common single defect class in this chapter, recurring across ex_4.13/14/15, ex_4.19, and 4 of the orphan sol_4.d.* row-reduction items), missing bracket delimiters, a digit-soup-garbled matrix product statement (ex_4.19), and one dropped leading digit (q_4.59). Two items were investigated and deliberately NOT corrected because the disagreement is between the two independent SOURCE PDFs themselves, not an extraction fault: q_4.56's textbook question gives matrix A with positive entries while the solutions manual's own worked solution uses negative entries for the same positions (flagged for the user's decision, not the narrow same-page unit-type exception); a pre-existing solutions-manual mislabel in q_4.16's cofactor step (M_21 written where A_23 is meant, correct numeric value used regardless) reproduced faithfully. The chapter's genuine "Example 21" cross-reference (a leftover, never-updated pointer from a pre-rationalisation edition, appearing in a Remark after Example 10) was confirmed printed exactly as extracted and left untouched, since correcting textbook wording is not this stage's call. A recurring, lower-severity pattern noted across several batches - matrices missing \left[/\right] bracket delimiters in a way that doesn't affect the numeric content (e.g. ex_4.16, ex_4.18's final column-vector display) - was left as a follow-up recommendation rather than exhaustively swept this pass, since it is cosmetic/rendering-only, not a content error.

Post-hoc noise-strip pass on 05_verify/chapter.verified.en.md, found via a proactive sweep (grep for #{1,4} inside question/solution fields) run before dispatching stage 6, rather than discovered later at stage 9 as happened for maths-12-3-en. Same root cause as that chapter's two noise-strip passes: a trailing bare "##" markdown-heading marker bled in from the following page/section boundary during stage 2 extraction, with only the marker surviving (heading text itself lost). Fixed by exact-match removal via mdio/render, not hand-editing: q_4.57.solution, q_4.58.solution, sol_4.misc.11.question, sol_4.misc.11.solution. Separately, this same sweep also surfaced a much larger, distinct pattern: 53 of the 61 real exercise items (q_4.1-q_4.61, excluding a handful) have their solution field prefixed with a restated copy of the question (sometimes verbatim, sometimes reworded/abbreviated by the solutions manual, occasionally including MCQ options) followed by a generic "Solution:"/"## Solution:" opener, before the real worked derivation begins. This is deliberately left UNTOUCHED here - CLAUDE.md's stage-8 section explicitly assigns "stripping redundant textbook openers ('हल :' and the like)" to stage 8's own tagging judgment pass, not stage 5 or 6; stage 6's sub-agents will be instructed not to reword or delete this leading text, only to leave it exactly as-is, so stage 8 can strip it uniformly later alongside the Hindi "हल :" case it was designed for.

English-only build. Stage 7 structuring dispatched as 11 parallel sub-agent batches (never pointed at step_7/PROMPT.md, each given only step_7/format.md's content-judgment instructions plus a chapter-specific addendum), covering all 106 items. Merge done via raw-text depth-based span extraction/substitution (not mdio - mdio.markdown_to_chapter() cannot parse nested containers), swapping each item's freshly-structured span into a skeleton rendered fresh from the flat chapter.simplified.en.md via render.render(), so section headers/dividers/frontmatter come from the one correct renderer call rather than being reconstructed by hand or accidentally inherited from a batch's own internal per-batch headers (the exact failure mode that hit maths-12-3-en's stage 7 merge). Structure added: `:::step` (numbered stages, using the fixed Given/Key-formula/Substitute/Conclusion labels where a solution's own flow genuinely fit that shape, freeform captions otherwise), `:::formula` (reusable governing equations), `:::concept` (standalone setup/definition statements), `:::note{type="recall"}` (a handful of orphan sol_4.d.* items' own row/column-identical justifications). No `:::table` or `:::figure` needed (chapter has neither). Per an explicit addendum given to every batch, the widespread leading restated-question-plus-"Solution:"/"## Solution:" opener noted at stage 6 was left as plain, unwrapped paragraph text in every batch - confirmed done correctly throughout - since stripping that class of redundant textbook opener is stage 8's job per CLAUDE.md, not stage 7's. Correction to an instruction I gave three batches (03: q_4.2/5/7/9/11/12, 04: q_4.14/15, 08: q_4.56): I had told them these multi-part items carry the known "duplicate trailing whole-item solution after per-part solutions" artifact from step_7/format.md 's judgement-call section. All three batches independently verified and reported this is factually wrong for this chapter - every multi-part item here has EMPTY per-part solution fields and exactly ONE combined item-level solution addressing all parts inline; there is no duplicate to flag for stage 8. Verified directly via mdio before accepting the correction. No harm done (the instruction was just "leave both as-is, flag it," which is harmless even when the premise is wrong), but stage 8 should NOT expect a redundant duplicate on q_4.2/5/7/9/11/12/14/15/56 - it should render the single item-level solution against all parts. q_4.56's separately-flagged genuine cross-source sign discrepancy (question vs. solution matrix signs) was confirmed left untouched by batch 08, as required. Two independent batches (05, 07) each caught and self-corrected one transcription slip (a dropped \end{aligned} line; a dropped lead-in word) via their own before/after line-diff verification before finishing - no externally-caught errors this stage.

English-only build. Tagging done by a custom deterministic Python walker over tag._parse()'s tree (same approach proven for maths-12-3-en) - no model call, matching RULES.md's "writing the JSON is code, not a model call." Given/key-formula/substitute/conclusion stages: explicit :::concept always "given" and explicit :::formula always "key_formula" regardless of position; a :::step already labelled with the fixed vocabulary (many were, from stage 7's own batches) mapped directly; everything else (unlabelled/freeform-labelled steps, and any bare unwrapped text directly inside a :::solution) got positional inference among that solution's own stageable-block sequence (first=given, last=conclusion, middle=substitute, single=conclusion), computed independently per item and per part. The chapter has no :::table, no :::figure and no :::answer containers anywhere (final_answer is empty for every item - the numeric answer lives as the tail of the solution text itself), so those three fields are empty/absent throughout. Noise stripped: the widespread leading restated-question-plus-"Solution:"/"## Solution:" opener flagged at stages 6-7 (present at the very front of the great majority of exercise items' solution fields) was stripped from the first text leaf of every :::solution node, English-language equivalent of the "हल :" case this stage's own prompt describes - matching what stages 6/7 deliberately left in place for this stage to handle. The 9 multi-part items flagged at stage 7 (q_4.2/5/7/9/11/12/14/15/56) do NOT carry the "duplicate trailing whole-item solution" pattern the general rule warns about (confirmed independently by three stage-7 batches and by the coordinator via mdio before this stage ran): their parts have no :::solution of their own at all, so the item-level solution_blocks were kept as-is (not nulled) and each part's solution_blocks is naturally empty, letting stage 9 render the one combined solution against all of that item's parts. Gate: re-parsed the written JSON and compared item count/part count/figure count against a fresh, direct parse of structured.en.md (not numbers held in memory while writing) - all three match (106 items, matching the part count, 0 figures).
